product.name: Sol Invictus Hammered Band
product.subtitle: Hand-forged 18k solid gold finish with organic molten texture
product.materials: 18k Fairmined Gold Vermeil on 925 Recycled Sterling Silver
product.description: Forged individually over an anvil in our studio, each Sol Invictus ring bears unique micro-facets that capture daylight like ripples on Mediterranean waters. Designed to wear alone as a subtle statement or stacked.
product.craftStory: Heated with an artisan jewelers torch and cold-hammered by master silversmith Elena to impart an enduring organic texture that ages gracefully.
product.careGuide: Wipe gently with the included micro-suede artisan cloth after wearing. Store separately in your velvet keepsake pouch away from moisture.

product.name: Luna Baroque Pearl Talisman
product.subtitle: Organic cultured freshwater baroque pearl on hand-knotted silk cord
product.materials: Grade-AAA Keshi Freshwater Baroque Pearl, 14k Solid Gold Toggle Clasp
product.gemstone: Natural Baroque Keshi Pearl (no two pearls are identical)
product.description: Each Baroque pearl is selected by hand for its dramatic luminous contours and deep pearlescent fire. Suspended from hand-spun Japanese silk cord with an artisanal 14k gold sculpted loop clasp.
product.craftStory: Hand-drilled in small batches in our coastal studio and individually double-knotted to protect each pearl from friction.
product.careGuide: Pearls love natural skin moisture! Put on after cosmetics, perfumes, and hairspray. Never soak in harsh ultrasonic cleaners.
product.dimensions: Pearl length approx 18-22mm; 14k gold toggle diameter 12mm

orders.giftMessage: Happy 5th Anniversary, my love! Forged by hand.

product.name: Celestial Teal Sapphire Solitaire
product.subtitle: Ethically mined Montana teal sapphire set in granulated gold claw prongs
product.materials: 18k Solid Yellow Gold, Natural Untreated Montana Teal Sapphire
product.finish: Brushed Florentine band with polished claw bezels
product.gemstone: 1.1ct Natural Montana Sapphire (Ocean Teal hue with silk inclusions)
product.description: A mesmerizing shift from eucalyptus green to midnight ocean teal under changing light. Cut in an antique rose-cut silhouette and set in our signature hand-carved low-profile basket.
product.craftStory: Cast via lost-wax technique from hand-carved jeweler’s wax, retaining the subtle impressions of the craftsman’s sculpting knives.
product.careGuide: Warm soapy water with a baby toothbrush restores full brilliance. Avoid heavy manual labor or gym impacts.
product.dimensions: Center stone: 6mm diameter; Band taper: 2.2mm to 1.6mm

products.name: Ginkgo Botanical Drop Earrings
products.subtitle: Delicate hand-chiseled fan leaves with kinetic ear wire movement
products.materials: Heavy 18k Gold Plated Brass & Hypoallergenic 14k Solid Gold Posts
products.finish: Satin ribbed leaf veining with mirror polished perimeter
products.description: Inspired by ancient ginkgo biloba groves in Kyoto, these lightweight mobile drops sway gently with your movement, catching overhead light with subtle radiance.
products.craftStory: Each delicate leaf pattern is manually stamped and file-shaped by artisan hands before undergoing thick gold plating for years of tarnish resistance.
products.careGuide: Avoid contact with chlorine, perfumes, and saltwater. Clean with a dry cotton swab.
products.dimensions: Total drop length: 38mm; Leaf width: 22mm; Weight: 3.2g per ear (featherlight)

products.name: Aegis Sculpted Silver Cuff
products.subtitle: Substantial solid recycled 925 sterling silver wrist torque
products.finish: Oxidized recesses with high-buff raised hammer facets
products.description: A sculptural wrist cuff engineered for both day-to-day comfort and striking presence. Gently malleable to fit any wrist diameter comfortably without pinching.
products.craftStory: Formed from heavy-gauge solid silver ingot rolled through a vintage rolling mill and hand-planished over a steel horn stake.
products.careGuide: Sterling silver loves being worn daily. If oxidation fades, a light buff with silver polish cloth brings out the deep dimensional contrast.
products.dimensions: Cuff width: 14mm tapering to 8mm ends; Metal thickness: 2.5mm

products.name: Soleil Ancient Sun Medallion
products.subtitle: Cast relief coin pendant featuring solar rays and bezel-set diamond
products.materials: 18k Vermeil (2.5 microns) on 925 Silver, Lab-Grown Conflict-Free Diamond
products.description: Embodying dawn and boundless optimism, the Soleil coin features an off-center recessed sunburst with a sparkling diamond star at its focal point.
products.craftStory: Direct replica of an artifact carved in wax by studio founder Maya, preserved in cast gold vermeil with an ultra-thick 2.5 micron micron layer.
products.careGuide: Store flat to prevent chain tangles. Remove before swimming or sleeping.
products.dimensions: Medallion diameter: 19mm; Chain: 1.4mm diamond-cut wheat chain

products.name: Amor Fati Ceremonial Curved Band
products.subtitle: Chevron nesting wedding band designed to hug solitaire rings seamlessly
products.materials: Solid 14k Warm Peach Gold, Micro-Pave Moissanite Accents
products.finish: Satin silk band with high-polish prong settings
products.description: Specially contoured with a graceful arch that slides underneath or hugs engagement solitaires without leaving an unsightly gap.
products.craftStory: Custom fitted using 3D microscope setting ensuring micro-claws hold every gemstone with utmost lifetime security.
products.careGuide: Includes complimentary annual prong inspection and professional ultrasonic cleaning certificate.

products.name: Kintsugi Raw Emerald Huggies
products.subtitle: Golden seam texture inspired by Japanese porcelain repair with raw emerald baguettes
products.materials: 18k Gold Plated 925 Silver, Natural Zambian Raw Emeralds
products.description: Celebrating beauty in imperfection. A crackle of golden lightning embraces an uncut green emerald slice that glows vibrantly against the earlobe.
products.craftStory: Individual emerald rough stones are cleaved by hand along their natural crystalline planes, meaning no two earrings share the exact same facet reflections.
products.careGuide: Emeralds are softer stones (7.5-8 Mohs). Clean with gentle damp cloth; never steam-clean.
products.dimensions: Hoop outer diameter: 14mm; Inner diameter: 10mm; Emerald drop: 6x4mm
